description: Structured Pydantic schema for CustomerIdentifier agent output.

primary_customers.description: Primary target customers who buy or pay for the solution.
primary_customers.title: Primary Customers

secondary_customers.description: Secondary target customers or secondary buyer personas.
secondary_customers.title: Secondary Customers

end_users.description: Actual end users who use the product day-to-day.
end_users.title: End Users

decision_makers.description: Key decision makers involved in purchasing or procurement.
decision_makers.title: Decision Makers

customer_segments.description: Core customer segment categories (e.g. B2B Hospitals, Private Clinics).
customer_segments.title: Customer Segments

demographics.description: Demographic or firmographic characteristics of target users.
demographics.title: Demographics

geographic_markets.description: Primary geographic markets or regional focus areas.
geographic_markets.title: Geographic Markets

pain_points.description: Core pain points experienced by target customers.
pain_points.title: Pain Points

motivations.description: Key purchasing motivations and value drivers.
motivations.title: Motivations

adoption_barriers.description: Potential barriers to customer adoption or purchase.
adoption_barriers.title: Adoption Barriers

willingness_to_pay.description: Estimated willingness to pay rating or level ('low', 'medium', 'high', or detailed description).
willingness_to_pay.title: Willingness To Pay
